name: Dead
text: The fighter is killed instantly.

name: Deep Wound
text: The fighter will die unless you take them to a surgeon. You may remove 15gc from the warband stash to roll a D6. On a 1-2, the fighter dies (but you retain their equipment!). On a 3+, the fighter survives.

name: Infection
text: The fighter survives but will miss the next battle.

name: Wyrdlung Rot
text: This fighter can only make one Move action per battle round.

name: Crippled Leg
text: Decrease the fighter's Move characteristic by 1.

name: Fractured Arm
text: Decrease the fighter's Fight and Shoot characteristics by 1.

name: Devastated Eye
text: Reduce the range of any weapons equipped by this fighter by half (to a minimum of 1").

name: Festering Wound
text: Decrease the fighter's Health characteristic by 4.

name: Nervous Tick
text: Decrease the fighter's Bravery characteristic by 1.

name: Stupidity
text: Unless activated within 3" of a visible friendly `HERO` or enemy fighter, roll a D6. On a 1-4, this fighter makes a Wait action. On a 5+, this fighter may activate as normal.

name: Hallucinations
text: This fighter must pass a Bravery test whenever they are activated within 1" of an enemy fighter, or become panicked.

name: Claustrophobia
text: Whenever this fighter ends a move action or is activated underneath a platform, it must pass a Bravery test or become panicked.

name: Alcoholic
text: This fighter cannot make reactions.

name: Kleptomania
text: Reduce all income by 10gc.

name: Paranoia
text: This fighter counts as panicked while within 1" of friendly fighters.

name: Flesh Wound
text: The fighter suffers no lasting effects.

name: Robbed
text: All equipment carried by this fighter is lost.

name: Captured
text: The fighter is captured by your opponent's warband. You must offer your opponent half of the fighter's recruitment cost, or concede 1 favour to get them back.

name: Hatred
text: This fighter hates the enemy fighter that took them out of action, and may turn a hit into a critical hit when making attack actions against that enemy fighter.

name: Hardened
text: Increase the Bravery characteristic of this fighter by 1.

name: Terrible Scars
text: This fighter gains the `TERRIFYING` keyword.

name: Against All Odds
text: This fighter earns a level of Renown.
